review_basis: Epsilon retains Playwright as its regression backbone.
Each tenant runs under a scoped cross-account role; screenshots and results are retained.
Successful explored trajectories are saved for replay; vendor measurements are not independent benchmarks.

review_basis: One promptable speech model supports transcription, speaker labels and translation.
Foreground applications and background agents share GPU compute, with a user-selected priority.
Unified memory is shared by CPU and GPU; future quantized speech-model versions are not already delivered.
stories.limitations: No fabricated app control knob, memory-to-permission flow, measured speed, resource percentages, privacy guarantee, or claim that forthcoming quantized versions are available.
